meta.title: Privacy Policy • CrookCatcher Android App
meta.description: Privacy policy for CrookCatcher, the Android app that takes pictures when wrong passwords are entered.

hero.title: Privacy Policy
hero.lead: CrookCatcher is designed with your privacy in mind. Here's how we keep your data safe and private.

sections.title: Camera
sections.body:
• CrookCatcher uses the camera permission to take pictures and record videos when a wrong password, PIN code, or lock pattern is entered, based on the number of attempts you specify in the app's settings under the 'Failed Unlock' preference.
  • CrookCatcher will not take pictures or record videos at any other times, unless other specific features have been enabled by you in the app.
  • Pictures and videos are emailed to you if the email function is enabled in CrookCatcher's settings. See the Email section below for more details. Pictures and videos may also be uploaded to Google Drive if enabled by you.
  • Otherwise, pictures and videos are stored only on your device and are not shared with the developer or any third party.

sections.title: Location
sections.body:
• If enabled in the settings, CrookCatcher finds your device's location in the background when it takes a picture.
  • CrookCatcher will not access your location at any other time.
  • The location is saved with the picture and emailed to you if the email function is enabled.
  • Your location data is not shared with the developer or any third party.

sections.title: Microphone
sections.body:
• When video recording is enabled, CrookCatcher will access the microphone to record videos.
  • Microphone access is only granted when you enable this feature and is only used for recording videos.

sections.title: Email
sections.body:
• CrookCatcher asks you to sign in with your Gmail account and grant permission to 'send emails on your behalf'. This avoids sending sensitive data through third-party servers. To revoke this permission, visit https://myaccount.google.com/permissions.
  • This does not grant CrookCatcher access to read your emails, manage contacts, or perform other actions.
  • Emails are only sent to the address specified in the 'Send email to' setting and only when specific conditions are met, which you specify in the app.
  • You can always see in your Gmail account which emails CrookCatcher has sent.
  • Your email address is not shared with the developer or any third party.

sections.title: Usage Statistics and Crash Reports
sections.body: Unless you opt out, CrookCatcher sends usage statistics and crash reports to Google (Firebase Analytics and Crashlytics) to improve performance and fix bugs. This includes events such as when an email is sent or which screen you open, your device model, Android version, app version, approximate region, and a random installation ID. It does not include your photos, videos, location or email address. You can opt out by unticking an option at the bottom of the settings menu in CrookCatcher.

sections.title: Ads
sections.body: The free version of CrookCatcher shows ads from Google AdMob. To show ads, Google receives your device's advertising ID and IP address, plus information about your device and how you interact with ads. Where required, such as in the European Economic Area and the UK, CrookCatcher asks for your consent first through Google's consent form. CrookCatcher does not give AdMob your photos, videos, location or email address. Pro users see no ads. Read how Google uses data in advertising.

sections.title: Purchases
sections.body: Purchases and subscriptions are handled by Google Play. CrookCatcher uses RevenueCat to manage subscriptions and unlock Pro. RevenueCat receives a random anonymous user ID, your purchase and subscription status, your country and basic device information. It does not receive your name, email address, photos, videos or location. See the RevenueCat privacy policy.

sections.title: Data Security
sections.body: We value your trust and are committed to protecting your data. Your photos, videos and location are stored on your device, or sent directly to you via email if enabled. They are not shared with the developer. The only data that reaches third-party services is the usage, crash, advertising and purchase data described above.

sections.title: Controller and Your Rights
sections.body: The controller for this app is Jakob Harteg (see the Impressum), reachable at contact@crookcatcher.app. Under data protection laws such as the GDPR, you can ask for access to, correction or deletion of data about you, object to processing, and withdraw your consent at any time. You can also complain to your local data protection authority.

sections.title: Changes to this Privacy Policy
sections.body: This privacy policy applies to the most recent version of CrookCatcher. We may update our Privacy Policy from time to time. You're advised to review this page periodically for any changes. Changes are effective immediately after they're posted on this page.

note:
Data is used solely to enable CrookCatcher to function and improve, to show ads in the free version and to process purchases. We do not sell your data.

CrookCatcher complies with the Official User Data Policy for Google API Services.
